description:
The Team:

Cundall is an award-winning global, multi-disciplinary consultancy with a strong and growing presence across the Asia-Pacific region. Our leadership in sustainable business was recognized when Cundall received the World Green Building Council’s 2020 Business Leadership in Sustainability Award for the APAC region, reflecting our commitment to embedding sustainability into the way we work and the outcomes we deliver for the built environment.

Sustainability underpins everything we do. We empower our people to drive positive change, decarbonize the built environment and create energy-efficient, resilient and climate-responsive buildings and communities.

Our Building Services team delivers integrated, resilient and technology-led solutions for complex buildings and infrastructure. Our Building Automation, ELV and ICT specialists work across commercial, mission-critical, healthcare, hospitality and mixed-use developments, combining controls and systems-integration expertise with a practical understanding of construction, commissioning and building operations.

The Role:

This is an excellent opportunity for a Building Automation and ELV/ICT Engineer or Senior Engineer to join our Chennai office and contribute to projects across India, the Middle East and the wider Asia-Pacific region.

We are seeking an engineer with strong consultancy design experience in Building Management Systems (BMS), building automation and controls, supported by capability in Extra-Low Voltage (ELV), Information and Communications Technology (ICT) and electronic security systems.

The successful candidate will lead or develop coordinated controls and ELV designs from concept through construction and commissioning for commercial buildings, data centres and other complex facilities.

The role requires confident engagement with clients, architects, MEP engineers, contractors, controls specialists, system integrators and vendors, together with sound engineering judgement and strong technical documentation, coordination and communication skills.

Key Responsibilities:

* Develop Building Management System and building automation designs, including controls philosophies, points schedules, sequences of operation, system architectures, network topologies, plant schematics, control-panel requirements, integration matrices and performance specifications.
* Design and coordinate controls for HVAC, central utility plants, electrical monitoring, energy metering, lighting and other building systems, with particular emphasis on mission-critical facilities and data centres.
* Define interfaces and data exchange between BMS, SCADA, EPMS, fire alarm, security, lighting control, lifts, packaged plant and other third-party systems using appropriate open protocols.
* Design ELV and ICT systems, including fire detection and alarm, voice evacuation/public address, CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, structured cabling, LAN/Wi-Fi infrastructure, intercom, and other specialist systems as applicable.
* Prepare design criteria, layouts, schematics, calculations, technical specifications, equipment schedules, bills of quantities, cost inputs and tender documentation.
* Coordinate automation and ELV requirements with architectural, electrical, mechanical, fire-and-life-safety, security, IT and structural disciplines, including sensors, control devices, panels, power supplies, containment, network infrastructure and equipment-space requirements.
* Review vendor submissions, shop drawings, control schematics, software and graphics proposals, material submittals, method statements and technical deviations for compliance with the design intent and project requirements.
* Support tender evaluations, value engineering, technical clarifications and assessments of controls contractors, OEMs and system integrators.
* Contribute to BIM-led coordination and work effectively with Revit and CAD technicians to deliver accurate, coordinated drawings and models.
* Manage assigned deliverables, budgets and programmes across multiple projects while maintaining Cundall’s quality and safety expectations.

  
The Skills:

Qualifications and Experience:

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Instrumentation, Controls, Mechatronics, Telecommunications or a related engineering discipline.
* Typically 4–8 years of relevant consultancy or design experience for Engineer/Senior Engineer level, with demonstrable building automation or BMS experience; candidates with stronger leadership experience may be considered for a more senior position.
* Proven experience developing BMS controls philosophies, points schedules, sequences of operation, system architectures, integration requirements and commissioning documentation is essential.
* Experience producing coordinated Building Automation and ELV/ICT designs for commercial, data centre, healthcare, hospitality, industrial or large infrastructure projects.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD is essential; working knowledge of Revit, Navisworks and BIM coordination workflows is strongly preferred.
* Ability to develop technical specifications, BOQs, design reports, calculations, schematics and tender packages with limited supervision.
* Experience coordinating with clients, architects, MEP consultants, contractors, OEMs, controls specialists and system integrators.
* Familiarity with applicable Indian codes and approvals, including NBC requirements, relevant BIS/IS standards and local fire-authority expectations, together with commonly used international standards.
* Relevant certifications or training in BMS platforms, Niagara Framework, networking, RCDD, CCNA/CCNP or security systems are advantageous but not mandatory.

Technical Knowledge and Personal Attributes:

* Strong technical knowledge of BMS, HVAC controls, direct digital control, instrumentation, control panels, field devices, plant optimisation and energy-management strategies.
* Ability to write clear and technically robust sequences of operation for air-side, water-side, electrical and mission-critical systems, including normal, failure, standby and recovery modes.
* Knowledge of BACnet, Modbus, KNX, LonWorks, MQTT, OPC and common API or gateway-based integration approaches, including network architecture, interoperability and cybersecurity considerations.
* Understanding of BMS, SCADA and EPMS boundaries, high-level interfaces, alarm management, trending, graphics, reporting, analytics and data-centre monitoring requirements.
* Strong knowledge of IP-based CCTV, video management systems, access control, intrusion detection, fire detection and alarm, VESDA, public address/voice evacuation and structured cabling systems.
* Understanding of copper and fibre cabling, equipment-room planning, racks, pathways, containment, power supplies and resilience requirements.
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP networking, VLANs, PoE, switches, servers, storage, virtualisation and cybersecurity principles relevant to connected building systems.
* Awareness of relevant BIS/IS, NBC, ECBC, ASHRAE, CIBSE, ISO/IEC, TIA/EIA, NFPA and BS/EN requirements commonly referenced on Indian and international projects.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English; additional Indian language capability is welcome.
* Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a collaborative approach.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently when required and travel to project sites within India or internationally.

If you are motivated by technically challenging projects and want to develop high-performance Building Automation solutions integrated with ELV and ICT systems for the buildings of the future, this could be the role for you.

**Job Summary**
---------------

A Data Analyst interprets data and helps turn it into information that enables or improves a business process, thus affecting business decisions. Data Analysts gather information from various sources and interpret patterns and trends to make it digestible for others. They must have strong analytical skills, but above all have a burning curiosity to understand, and make sense of, data. They will work closely with:
  
• Data Managers, who define the team's business requirements, objectives, strategy and priorities
  
• Data Engineers, who design and implement the processes by which data is collected and generated
  
• Data Quality Analysts, who define data quality control requirements and oversee these on a day to day basis to ensure constant system health
  
• Upstream data teams, who provide the data that the analyst is sourcing
  
• Downstream Process Owners, who depend on the data to perform their business function
  
Data Analysts spend much of their time working with stakeholders to define data requirements, data transformation logic and supporting the delivery of these requirements from start to finish. They are experts in profiling data to understand its contents and will also have a working understanding of the business process or product that generated it in the first place. Data Analysts are the entry point to the FCC Data Team for most external stakeholders and as such will have a broad, but still detailed, understanding of all the data available and constantly seek opportunities for innovation and expansion. They are the primary liaison between up- and downstream teams

• Work with downstream FCC business process owners to constantly improve, refine and expand the datasets to improve the quality and effectiveness of those processes, as well as help them to make sense of the data, providing training where required, and derive meaningful BI / MI
  
• Conduct detailed analysis of upstream changes that impact FCC data – for example the introduction of a new products – to ensure that requirements remain up to date and define any new ones as necessary
  
• Identify areas of overlap or data gaps that can lead to increased value, either by eliminating redundant processes or expanding existing data models
  
• Produce accurate and insightful dashboards and reports detailing the health, content and insights available from the data, making that actionable for stakeholders and meaningful for management decision making

The Industrial Automation and PLC Programming Lead will serve as a technical subject\-matter expert for shop\-floor automation and controls systems supporting manufacturing operations and forward model programs.
This position combines hands\-on production support with long\-term technical standardization. The role will manage and prioritize automation\-related support requests, troubleshoot production\-impacting issues, perform root\-cause analysis, and serve as an escalation point for complex or recurring controls problems.
The position will also lead the development, documentation, and implementation of programming standards, reusable software libraries, naming conventions, controls templates, and engineering best practices. The role will work closely with manufacturing engineering, information technology, operational technology, equipment suppliers, system integrators, and plant support teams to ensure that automation solutions are reliable, secure, maintainable, and aligned with applicable organizational and Original Equipment Manufacturer standards.
**Production and Technical Support**
* Manage and prioritize technical support requests involving PLCs, HMIs, MES interfaces, robotics, and industrial connectivity systems.
* Provide advanced troubleshooting and programming support for production\-impacting controls and automation issues.
* Diagnose PLC logic, HMI application, communication, robotics, and shop\-floor system failures.
* Perform structured root\-cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
* Act as an escalation point for complex, recurring, or high\-impact technical issues.
* Coordinate with manufacturing, maintenance, controls engineering, information technology, operational technology, and supplier teams during issue resolution.
* Maintain accurate records of incidents, technical findings, implemented solutions, and lessons learned.
* Define and monitor appropriate service\-level measures and key performance indicators for issue response, resolution, system reliability, and recurring failures.

**Controls Standards and Standardization**
* Develop, document, implement, and maintain PLC and HMI programming standards.
* Establish consistent naming conventions, program structures, alarm strategies, diagnostic methods, and documentation requirements.
* Develop reusable logic modules, Add\-On Instructions, function blocks, HMI objects, templates, and software libraries.
* Lead the migration or alignment of legacy controls programs with approved standards and reusable architectures.
* Conduct technical design reviews and periodic audits to assess compliance with established controls standards.
* Identify opportunities to reduce engineering effort, improve maintainability, and increase consistency across equipment and manufacturing lines.
* Establish appropriate software backup, change\-management, release\-management, and version\-control practices for PLC, HMI, and robot programs.
* Maintain standard technical documents, implementation guidelines, checklists, and validation procedures.
* Support the structured rollout and adoption of new controls standards across relevant plants, programs, or production lines.

**PLC and HMI Engineering**
* Develop, modify, debug, validate, and support PLC applications using platforms such as Allen\-Bradley Studio 5000, Siemens TIA Portal, or equivalent industrial controls platforms.
* Develop and maintain HMI applications using platforms such as FactoryTalk View, Siemens WinCC, or equivalent technologies.
* Review and optimize PLC program architecture, sequencing, interlocks, alarms, fault handling, and equipment diagnostics.
* Support commissioning, production launch, equipment integration, and continuous\-improvement activities.
* Ensure that controls programs are appropriately documented, tested, backed up, and maintained.
* Support the implementation of effective equipment recovery, troubleshooting, and diagnostic features.

**Manufacturing Execution System Integration**
* Support and troubleshoot interfaces between manufacturing equipment, PLCs, supervisory systems, and Manufacturing Execution Systems.
* Investigate data\-quality, equipment\-status, production\-tracking, and system\-integration issues.
* Support industrial data exchange using technologies such as Open Platform Communications Unified Architecture, commonly known as OPC UA.
* Collaborate with MES and information technology teams to maintain reliable communication between shop\-floor controls and manufacturing applications.
* Help ensure the accuracy, availability, and integrity of manufacturing data.

* Support Industrial Internet of Things gateways, edge devices, sensors, communication brokers, and associated data pipelines.
* Develop or maintain standard configurations for industrial connectivity solutions.

* Work with information technology and operational technology teams to ensure industrial connectivity solutions meet applicable networking, cybersecurity, reliability, and data\-governance requirements.

* Coordinate with controls engineers, equipment suppliers, integrators, and production teams to resolve robot\-related manufacturing issues.
* Support robot program backup, change control, documentation, and recovery procedures.
* Identify opportunities to improve robot reliability, cycle performance, diagnostics, and maintainability.

* Participate in design reviews, software reviews, equipment acceptance activities, and launch\-readiness assessments.

 **Purpose of the Role**
Newell Brands is seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to join our Cloud Infrastructure team. This is a senior\-level, hands\-on role responsible for designing, securing, and operating cloud infrastructure across a multi\-cloud environment that spans Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, as well as on\-premises VMware ESXi infrastructure.  

While Microsoft Azure is the primary platform today, this role requires a strong multi\-cloud mindset and the ability to operate effectively across cloud providers as the organization's footprint evolves. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in cloud security, networking, and complex troubleshooting, and can work independently with minimal direction in a globally distributed team. This role requires a work schedule providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time, as well as availability outside normal hours for scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests. Experience with VMware technologies, including VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), is a valued plus. **Your Key Responsibilities:****Cloud Infrastructure \& Operations**

* Design, deploy, and manage scalable infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, including compute, storage, and container platforms such as AKS and EKS
* Maintain and optimize cloud account structures including Azure subscriptions, AWS accounts, and landing zones across providers
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates with a preference for cloud\-agnostic tooling where practical
* Implement automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, AWS CLI, and native cloud automation services to reduce manual effort and improve consistency
* Monitor infrastructure health across cloud platforms using Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, Log Analytics, and other native tools, responding proactively to alerts and capacity trends

**Cloud Security**

* Architect and enforce security controls across cloud environments in alignment with Zero Trust principles and a consistent multi\-cloud security posture
* Manage Azure Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) and AWS IAM policies across cloud environments
* Conduct security assessments and remediate findings from vulnerability scans, cloud security posture tools, and policy compliance checks
* Manage secrets governance including Azure Key Vault and AWS Secrets Manager, encryption at rest and in transit, and key lifecycle management
* Maintain compliance posture across regulatory and corporate policy requirements in all cloud environments

**Cloud Networking**

* Design and manage virtual network topologies across Azure (VNets, hub\-spoke) and AWS (VPCs, Transit Gateway) with consistent routing and segmentation standards
* Configure and maintain cloud\-native firewalls, Network Security Groups (NSGs), security groups, and DDoS protection across providers
* Implement and operate load balancing and traffic management services including Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door, and AWS equivalents
* Manage Azure DNS, Private DNS Zones, AWS Route 53, and name resolution across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments
* Troubleshoot complex network issues across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments including routing, connectivity, and DNS resolution failures

**Troubleshooting \& Incident Response**

* Serve as a senior escalation point for cloud infrastructure incidents across all platforms, driving rapid diagnosis and resolution
* Lead post\-incident reviews, document root cause analyses, and implement preventive measures
* Use platform\-native diagnostics and log analytics tools to investigate performance degradation and outages
* Participate in on\-call rotation for critical infrastructure support as needed

**Maintenance, DR, \& Business Continuity**

* Actively participate in monthly infrastructure maintenance windows, which are scheduled outside of normal business hours
* Support semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests, including failover validation, documentation, and post\-test reporting
* Contribute to DR planning and runbook development to ensure recovery procedures remain current and tested across cloud environments

**On\-Premises \& Collaboration**

* Support VMware ESXi and on\-premises virtualization environments as needed
* Contribute to cloud adoption and migration projects, providing multi\-cloud expertise during design and execution phases
* Share technical knowledge across the team; contribute to infrastructure standards, runbooks, and architectural decision records

 **What You’ll Need:****Minimum:*** 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in cloud infrastructure, with strong depth in at least two major cloud platforms (Azure required; AWS strongly preferred)
* Demonstrated expertise in cloud security fundamentals including RBAC/IAM, Zero Trust principles, secrets governance, and encryption; working knowledge of Entra ID, Conditional Access, and PIM
* Strong cloud networking skills spanning virtual networks, firewalls, load balancers, DNS, and Private DNS Zones across Azure and AWS
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues across compute, storage, networking, and identity layers in a multi\-cloud environment
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates
* Proficiency in cloud automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, and/or AWS CLI
* Familiarity with cloud monitoring and observability tools across providers (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, AWS CloudWatch)
* Comfortable working outside normal hours to support scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual DR tests
* Ability to work a shift providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time
* Strong documentation skills and ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders
* Business\-level English proficiency (verbal and written) required

description:
We are seeking an experienced Manager \- Reliability \& Root Cause Analysis to lead a multidisciplinary engineering team within the Fleet Intelligence \& Reliability organization. The team is responsible for identifying systemic fleet risks, determining the physical and systemic causes of complex failures, and ensuring that corrective and preventive actions deliver measurable and sustainable reliability improvement across the global Solar and Storage installed fleet.
  

This role owns the technical governance of Root Cause Analyses for complex, high\-impact, recurring, and fleet\-wide issues. The manager will ensure that investigations are evidence\-based, technically rigorous, and completed with clear accountability from initial containment through corrective\-action validation and fleet\-risk closure.
  

The leader will manage engineers across relevant disciplines, which may include power electronics, electrical systems, mechanical systems, embedded software, plant controls, and systems engineering. The position requires close partnership with Fleet Performance \& Analytics, Product Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Project Engineering, Field Operations, and commercial teams to convert fleet experience into product and operational improvement.
**Job Description**
===================


**Roles and Responsibilities**
==============================


* Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary engineering team responsible for fleet reliability, failure investigation, and Root Cause Analysis.
* Own and continuously improve the RCA governance process, including issue prioritization, ownership assignment, technical reviews, milestones, escalation, corrective\-action tracking, validation, and closure criteria.
* Lead investigations of complex, high\-impact, systemic, and recurring failures affecting solar inverters, battery energy storage systems, plant controls, power conversion equipment, and associated interfaces.
* Ensure investigations are grounded in verified evidence, operating data, event logs, inspection results, failure reproduction, laboratory analysis, engineering calculations, and appropriate structured problem\-solving methods.
* Differentiate failure symptoms, direct physical causes, contributing factors, systemic causes, and organizational causes, ensuring that conclusions are supported by evidence.
* Drive immediate containment, short\-term mitigation, and permanent corrective and preventive actions with the relevant engineering and operational owners.
* Prioritize investigations using safety exposure, customer impact, availability loss, recurrence, fleet population, warranty exposure, and financial consequence.
* Maintain a fleet\-level view of failure modes and systemic risk across products, projects, regions, configurations, software versions, suppliers, and operating environments.
* Partner with Fleet Performance \& Analytics to use fleet data, trends, event signatures, and risk models to detect emerging issues, quantify exposure, and verify corrective\-action effectiveness.
* Translate field and fleet learning into recommendations for product requirements, design changes, validation plans, software releases, manufacturing processes, supplier controls, maintenance strategies, and technical documentation.
* Provide technical leadership during critical fleet events, customer escalations, and executive\-level issue reviews.
* Ensure customer\-facing and internal RCA reports are accurate, evidence\-based, clear, and delivered in accordance with committed milestones.
* Develop and maintain reusable engineering knowledge, including RCA standards, failure libraries, lessons learned, troubleshooting guides, technical advisories, and investigation templates.
* Support the definition and deployment of Change, Modification, and Upgrade actions resulting from fleet reliability findings.
* Establish and monitor meaningful metrics such as RCA cycle time, milestone adherence, recurrence rate, corrective\-action closure, investigation backlog, and quantified fleet\-risk reduction.
* Promote a culture of safety, technical rigor, accountability, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================


* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Control Systems Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related technical field.
* Demonstratable experience in engineering, reliability, failure analysis, product engineering, installed\-base engineering, or a related technical function.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex technical investigations or RCAs involving multidisciplinary systems.
* Demonstrated experience leading engineers, technical teams, or significant cross\-functional engineering programs.
* Experience with power generation, renewable energy, battery energy storage, power conversion, industrial automation, or comparable complex industrial equipment.
* Ability and willingness to travel internationally as required.

**Desired Characteristics**
===========================


* Advanced degree in engineering, reliability, systems engineering, or a related discipline.
* Previous people\-leadership experience within a global engineering or technical organization.
* Strong knowledge of solar inverters, battery energy storage systems, power electronics, plant controls, electrical protection, thermal management, and industrial communication networks.
* Experience applying structured investigation methodologies such as Fault Tree Analysis, 5 Whys, Ishikawa analysis, 8D, Kepner\-Tregoe, or Failure Mode and Effects Analysis.
* Knowledge of reliability engineering, failure mechanisms, accelerated testing, design validation, reliability growth, and corrective\-action effectiveness assessment.
* Experience analyzing operational data, waveforms, alarms, event logs, failed components, inspection evidence, and intervention history.
* Strong systems thinking, technical judgment, and ability to make risk\-based decisions with incomplete or evolving information.
* Proven ability to influence Product Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Operations, and commercial teams in a matrixed environment.
* Strong customer\-facing skills and the ability to communicate sensitive technical findings with clarity, credibility, and appropriate transparency.
* Ability to manage multiple high\-priority investigations across a global fleet.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Self\-starting attitude with the ability to establish structure, set priorities, develop people, and drive issues through sustainable closure.

description:

**Job Description:**

At Barry\-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we’ve grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the St. Louis Business Journal list of the city’s Top 150 Privately Held Companies.

The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services—providing critical support to Barry\-Wehmiller divisions worldwide.


**Our culture is built on:**

* Ownership – Drive features end\-to\-end, from design to deployment.
* Flexibility – A friendly, results\-oriented environment that respects your time.
* Empowerment – Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact.
* Learning and Growth – Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development.

**Career Development and Global Exposure**

  

At Barry\-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You’ll have access to world\-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you’ll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting\-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive.


If you’re ready to bring your best thinking to a high\-impact, future\-focused environment—where long\-term stability meets start\-up agility—and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we’d love to hear from you.


**Job Description**

We are looking for a **Senior Engineer – Controls** with 8\+ years of experience in the design, development, modification, migration, integration, and implementation of **PLC and HMI/SCADA systems for discrete machinery and equipment** .


The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience with a combination of **Siemens, Allen\-Bradley (Rockwell Automation), and Beckhoff** automation platforms. Experience in **printing, paper converting, packaging, textile, or other machinery/OEM industries** is highly preferred.


The engineer should be able to take a systems approach to understand the overall machine design, mechanical functions, electrical architecture, control philosophy, safety systems, and automation requirements, and develop robust PLC and HMI programs ensuring the overall functional quality and performance of the machinery/equipment.


The role will be responsible for the interface between **electrical hardware, PLC software, HMI/SCADA, drives, motion systems, instrumentation, and machine\-level automation** .


**Technical Skills**
--------------------

### **PLC \& HMI Platforms**

Strong hands\-on experience in one or more of the following platforms, with the ability to work across multiple automation platforms:


* **Siemens S7\-1200 / S7\-1500 PLCs**
* **Siemens Comfort Panels / Unified Comfort Panels**
* **Allen\-Bradley / Rockwell Automation PLCs**
	+ ControlLogix
	+ CompactLogix
* **Beckhoff PLC / IPC\-based control systems**
	+ TwinCAT 3
	+ EtherCAT
* Experience with HMI/SCADA development and integration across Siemens, Allen\-Bradley, and Beckhoff platforms.

### **PLC \& HMI Development**

* Hands\-on experience developing **PLC and HMI programs from scratch** based on URS, functional specifications, and client standards.
* Ability to understand and develop PLC programs using:
	+ Ladder Logic
	+ Function Block Diagram
	+ Structured Text
	+ Sequential Function Chart
* Develop machine sequences, interlocks, alarms, permissives, recipes, diagnostics, and operator interfaces.
* Interface PLC programs with HMI/SCADA systems.
* Experience in modifying, debugging, migrating, and optimizing existing PLC/HMI programs.
* Experience with **machine\-level automation and discrete manufacturing applications** .
* HMI scripting/programming experience using **JavaScript, C\#, or similar technologies** is an added advantage.

**Siemens Automation**
----------------------

* Strong hands\-on experience with **Siemens S7\-1500 PLCs** .
* Experience with **TIA Portal V15\.1 or above** .
* TIA Portal V17/V18/V19 or later experience preferred.
* Siemens Comfort and Unified Comfort HMI development.
* PLC/HMI programming, troubleshooting, commissioning, and debugging.
* Experience with Siemens drives and motion systems is preferred.

**Allen\-Bradley / Rockwell Automation**
----------------------------------------

* Hands\-on experience with **Allen\-Bradley PLCs** .
* Experience with **ControlLogix and/or CompactLogix** platforms.
* Rockwell Studio 5000 / RSLogix programming experience.
* Allen\-Bradley HMI experience using **FactoryTalk View** is preferred.
* Experience with Rockwell drives, I/O, communication networks, and motion systems is an advantage.

**Beckhoff Automation**
-----------------------

* Hands\-on experience with **Beckhoff PLC/control systems** .
* Experience with **TwinCAT 3** programming and development.
* Knowledge of **EtherCAT** communication and distributed I/O systems.
* Experience with Beckhoff IPCs, motion control, servo systems, and drives is preferred.
* Experience developing machine control applications using Structured Text is an advantage.

**Industrial Communication \& Networking**
------------------------------------------

Good understanding of industrial communication protocols and networking, including:


* PROFINET / PROFIBUS
* EtherNet/IP
* EtherCAT
* AS\-i
* CAN / CANopen
* DeviceNet
* Modbus TCP/RTU
* OPC UA
* Other industrial Ethernet and fieldbus protocols

Ability to configure, troubleshoot, and integrate PLCs, remote I/O, drives, HMIs, sensors, and other automation devices over industrial networks.


**Drives, Motors \& Motion Control**
------------------------------------

* Knowledge of selection and application of motors, motor controllers, VFDs, servo drives, and motion\-control systems.
* Understanding of:
	+ Motor horsepower
	+ Torque
	+ Speed range
	+ Gear ratios
	+ Reduction ratios
	+ Acceleration/deceleration
* Experience with Siemens, Allen\-Bradley, or Beckhoff drives is preferred.
* Basic understanding of servo positioning and motion\-control applications.

**Instrumentation \& Control Components**
-----------------------------------------

Good understanding of selection and application of industrial control components, including:


* Sensors for flow, pressure, level, temperature, position, speed, counters, motion, vision, etc.
* Digital and analog sensors
* Proximity and photoelectric sensors
* Encoders
* Transducers
* Solenoid valves
* Relays
* Contactors
* On/Off control devices
* Analog I/O and signal conditioning
* A/D and D/A conversion
* I/P and P/I conversion

Understanding of sensor characteristics such as accuracy, precision, response time, repeatability, reliability, range, and environmental/temperature effects.


**FAT, SAT \& Commissioning**
-----------------------------

* Develop automation test cases and procedures for **Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT)** and **Site Acceptance Testing (SAT)** .
* Participate in FAT/SAT with customers and project teams.
* Hands\-on experience in machine installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and start\-up.
* Ability to troubleshoot PLC, HMI, drives, I/O, communication, and machine sequence issues.
* Experience with remote commissioning and troubleshooting tools.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites for commissioning and project support.

**Standards \& Compliance**
---------------------------

Working knowledge of applicable industry codes, standards, and regulations such as:


* ANSI
* ISA
* NEC
* NEMA
* NFPA
* OSHA
* UL

Experience working with machine safety systems and safety PLCs is an added advantage.


**Tool Skills**
===============

### **Mandatory / Core**

* **Siemens TIA Portal – V15\.1 or above**
* Siemens S7\-1500 PLC
* Siemens Comfort / Unified Comfort HMI
* **Allen\-Bradley / Rockwell Studio 5000**
* ControlLogix / CompactLogix
* **Beckhoff TwinCAT 3**
* EtherCAT

### **Preferred**

* TIA Portal V17\+
* FactoryTalk View
* Siemens / Rockwell / Beckhoff drives and motion systems
* OPC UA
* Industrial Ethernet networking
* HMI scripting / C\# / JavaScript
* EPLAN or similar electrical engineering tools

**Education \& Experience**
===========================

* Bachelor's degree in **Electrical \& Electronics Engineering (EEE), Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE), Instrumentation, or related engineering discipline** .
* **8\+ years of experience in industrial automation and controls engineering.**
* Strong hands\-on experience in PLC and HMI programming.
* Experience with **a combination of Siemens, Allen\-Bradley, and Beckhoff platforms** is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience developing PLC/HMI programs **from scratch** .
* Experience in machinery/OEM applications is highly preferred.
* Experience in **printing, packaging, paper converting, textile, or other discrete machinery industries** is an advantage.
* Experience in machine commissioning and customer\-site support is preferred.

**Key Result Areas**
====================

* Configure automation hardware and software according to project design specifications.
* Develop PLC and HMI programs from scratch based on machine automation requirements.
* Integrate Siemens, Allen\-Bradley, and Beckhoff automation platforms with machine hardware and control systems.
* Ensure optimal performance, reliability, quality, and responsiveness of PLC/HMI applications.
* Troubleshoot PLC, HMI, drives, motion, I/O, and industrial communication issues.
* Follow software development, change\-management, and version\-control procedures.
* Maintain proper documentation of PLC/HMI software and project changes.
* Manage assigned projects and deliver according to agreed schedules and scope.
* Communicate project progress, technical issues, and risks to project stakeholders.
* Support FAT, SAT, machine start\-up, commissioning, and customer acceptance.
* Provide technical support to internal teams and customers as required.

**Soft Skills**
===============

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Logical and systematic approach to problem\-solving.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Ability to understand complex machine sequences and identify key technical issues.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.
* Strong customer\-facing and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and changing project requirements.
* Willingness to learn and work across multiple automation platforms.

**Travel**
==========

Occasional domestic and/or international travel may be required, up to **15%** , for customer meetings, FAT, SAT, installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and project support.


**Preferred Candidate Profile**
-------------------------------

The ideal candidate will be a **multi\-platform Controls Engineer** with strong practical experience in:


**Siemens \+ Allen\-Bradley \+ Beckhoff**

with hands\-on capability in:


**PLC Programming HMI Development Drives/Motion Industrial Communication Machine Integration FAT/SAT Commissioning**

Experience with **OEM/discrete machinery** , particularly printing, packaging, paper converting, or textile machinery, will be a strong advantage.
